title: Algebra Basics Study Guide
subject: Mathematics
content: Solve linear equations by isolating the variable: do the same operation to both sides. Review exponents, factoring and word-problem setup before speed drills.

title: Geometry Formula Sheet
subject: Mathematics
content: Triangle area = ½ × base × height. Circle area = πr². Pythagorean theorem: a² + b² = c². Memorize volume formulas for prisms, cylinders and spheres.

title: Mixed Math Mock Exam
subject: Mathematics
content: Set a 60-minute timer. Attempt every item once, mark skipped items, then return. Review mistakes by topic and note which were careless errors.

title: Grammar Essentials
subject: English
content: Focus on subject-verb agreement, verb tenses, parallel structure and pronoun reference. Read each sentence aloud; errors are often easier to hear.

title: Reading Comprehension Strategies
subject: Reading Comprehension
content: Read the questions first, then the passage. Summarize each paragraph in a few words. Distinguish what the author states from what you infer.

title: Biology Concepts Summary
subject: Science
content: Cells and organelles, genetics basics, ecosystems and the scientific method. Make flashcards for terms and practice reading graphs.

title: Physics and Chemistry Quick Notes
subject: Science
content: Motion and forces, energy, the periodic table, balancing equations. Practice unit conversions and always write units in your solutions.

title: Current Affairs Primer
subject: General Knowledge
content: Follow reputable news sources for 15 minutes daily. Keep notes on government, economy, science and culture headlines, with dates.

title: Pattern and Logic Practice
subject: Abstract Reasoning
content: Look for number series, letter patterns and shape transformations such as rotation and reflection. Name the rule before choosing an answer.

title: Test-Day Learning Tips
subject: General Knowledge
content: Sleep well the night before, bring your permit and valid ID, arrive early, skip hard items first, and check the clock every 15 minutes.
